Proposition
[Two-dimensional matrix Harnack estimate] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-ii:page-0293 1. ch15:15.10\group Surface Harnack Estimates

For a complete surface Ricci flow on $[0,T)$ with bounded positive scalar curvature, \[ abla _i abla _j\log R+ rac12Rg_{ij}+ rac1{2t}g_{ij}>0. \]
Proof

\sketch Let $L=\log R$ and $H_{ij}= abla _i abla _jL+ frac 12(R+t^{-1})g_{ij}$. Calculation gives

\[ \partial _tH_{ij}=\Delta H_{ij}+2 abla _kH_{ij} abla _kL +2H_{ik}H_{jk}-(2t^{-1}+3R)H_{ij}+R(\operatorname {tr}H)g_{ij}. \]

The tensor is positive for small time. At a first null eigenvector every reaction term surviving contraction with that vector is nonnegative, so the tensor maximum principle precludes such a first zero.

□
